notes.title: Tile Lands v1.3.3 Out Now
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]

How's about that v1.3.2 release hey? 😂 But in all seriousness, I want to apologise again for the bugs that came through into production, all quite game breaking and really ruin the experience! Thanks everyone who reached out to let me know about them and help me solve some issues.

[h3]Some important things to note:[/h3]
The issue occurring where the UI would disappear when you lose the game has been solved - some people have raised concern that their score will have been lost, fortunately this is [b]not[/b] the case! All scores achieved during this build were successfully pushed to the monthly and all-time leaderboards and can be seen properly now when viewing the leaderboard or seeing a game over screen.

[b]Save/Load Fix[/b]
The other major bug was relating to loading games which had quests present on the board. There was an issue in the backend where it wasn't correctly saving the tile that they had been on so when the game went to load it would throw an error and freeze. This is now resolved and data will save correctly, [b]however any data saved previously will still be incorrect.[/b] You will need to start a new game on this update to resolve the error. Again, I'm very sorry for this and for any data loss - it's a frustrating oversight and I can't apologise enough.

Outside of that, this release includes the following additional small tweaks:
[list]
[*] Minor visual improvements to Volcano, Mountain, Field, Lake and Marshland tiles
[*] Fixed a bug with the Volcano where it would launch boulders at the wrong tiles
[*] Tiles destroyed by the Volcano are now added directly to the bottom of the deck instead of adding Wastelands
[*] Fixed language syntax issues on description of Mountain tile
[*] Updated the Volcano to show a description of what it does
[*] Tile merges now cascade: When a merge completes that would lead to another merge, this merge takes place immediately so merges can be chained and better placed - the placement of any merge is always based around the tile placed that would cause the merge (i.e. the tile that you just placed down or that was the result of the previous merge in a chain)
[*] Resolved a visual bug with various tiles not rendering correctly in the deck
[/list]

I hope you guys enjoy playing this fixed update! The score balance has changed a fair bit in comparison to v1.3.1 so if you have any thoughts or feedback please let me know! We're continuing to work on the game and improve it for future updates and some other exciting things that we're working on in the background.

Thanks and big love!
~ The Shiba Dog Studios Team ✨

notes.title: Tile Lands v1.3.2 Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, everyone![/h1]

For the first time in a while, we have an update for Tile Lands and (while it may be small) it's a pretty decent one! 🤩

[h2]Update Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Official Controller Support
[*] Added support for Saving mid-run*
[*] Introduction of Monthly Leaderboards
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Tile Drawing system for better balance
[*] Updated UI designs
[*] Updated full Credits page
[/list]

We haven't forgotten about the other changes, improvements and new tiles - life's just been crazy busy! But we have some really exciting news around the corner and all the new features won't be far behind

Big love and many thanks for your continued support
~ Cuba and the Shiba Team

[i]*The update to the save system to support saving a run changes the way that the game stores which tiles have been discovered - this means that on updating, the game will reset all unlocked tiles to default (i.e. none!) - for this I apologise, there wasn't any easy way I could get around it but at the current stage before any new tiles are added it's a better time to have that loss now than later! Appreciate your understanding[/i]

notes.title: Our New Discord Is Here!

notes.title: Tile Lands 1.3.1 Patch Release
notes.content:
Just a little update to do some tiiiiny bug fixes and patch a couple things for Quality of Life :D
v2.0 is well underway, I'll look to share some info on the timings and progress of it all with you soon!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Turn Fast-Forward increasing turn duration in some cases
[*] Scores now submit to the Leaderboard when ending a round manually
[*] Quarries are now capped at stocking no more coal than would yield a reward when activated
[*] Fixed Quarries getting production bonus from connected Quarries as well as adjacent Quarries
[*] Power Stations are now capped at stocking no more coal than would power a connected City
[*] Power Stations will now only produce one Power Line per activation - this has no impact on the coal cost
[/list]

notes.title: Tile Lands v1.3.0 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everybody![/h1]

I'd like to give a warm welcome to all the new player's we've had on the game these past couple of weeks - what a way to start the year! Thank you all so much for taking the time to play Tile Lands.
A real positive of having you all here has been the feedback we've been getting for how to improve the game - this update serves to cover some of these issues, though I'll be upfront and say that some of the larger changes which would affect how players can score will be postponed to the [b]Major Version 2.0 Update[/b] which is due in [i]March 2024[/i]

[h2]Community Highlight[/h2]
We'd like to give a brief shoutout to community users Meed and Melaroll - your reviews have been a major help and, despite having constructive feedback that could have pushed some to leave a negative, you chose to leave a positive review regardless and for that we're incredibly grateful! Your feedback is in here and the upcoming 2.0 release and has been a great use to us in planning what's to come 🥳

We'd also like to take a moment to appreciate content creators Olexa and RealCivilEngineer for their recent videos on the game which we can thank the new players for - creators like these make this endeavour all the more enjoyable and we're incredibly grateful to have had the opportunity to feature on these channels!

[h2]Update Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some Players Can't Place Tiles in the Tutorial
[*] UI Doesn't Load in Main Menu for Some Users*
[*] Fixed Factory Not Rewarding Tiles Sometimes
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shortened Duration of Rain on Mountains and Increased Periods of Drought
[*] Improved Wording of Connection Merge Rules to be Less Ambiguous
[*] Pirate Entity Now Shows as 'Pirate' Instead of 'Barbarian'
[/list]

Keep that feedback coming! We're really excited to show you all the new features and tiles coming in v2.0!

Big love and thanks,
~ Cuba and the Shiba Team 🥳✨

*[i]We've made updates to the way UI transitions and management is handled in the code which seems the most obvious candidate for this issue, however it's a but we've been unable to reproduce locally and debug - if this persists for you, please fill out [url=https://forms.gle/rMaNnoUGsQdHRtKE8]the Tile Lands Bug Report form[/url] with as much information as possible to help us get to the bottom of this![/i]

notes.title: Tile Lands v1.2.0 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there everyone![/h2]

First off, I'd like to say a massive thank you to everyone who's taken the time to play our little game - the reviews and feedback we've had so far have really made our days this past week! 🤩
From this feedback, we've become aware of some bugs and balancing issues in the game, this minor version update looks to patch some of these in addition to bringing in some additional features that can help you give feedback more easily

[h3]Community Feedback Highlight[/h3]
We'd like to give a brief shoutout to community user, Mer, with their recent review on the game including the suggestion to add a fast forward button during the scoring of a given turn - this was an excellent idea that makes a huge deal of sense and is now a feature within the game 😁 Thanks again, Mer!

[h3]Update Changelog[/h3]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed duplicate entry for Barbarian Camps having the chance to produce Barbarians
[*] Tiles upgraded with surrounding Ocean can now be upgraded with any Ocean-derived tile (Fishing Village, Oil Rig, Lighthouse, etc) and the Monument
[*] Corrected some typos in tile descriptions
[*] Fixed tiles being unable to be activated when an entity is stood on them
[/list]

[b]Balancing Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated logic of Power Lines and Power Stations - Power Stations can now power City tiles, connected via Power Lines, at the cost of stocked coal. Doing so will yield +25 points per powered City
[/list]

[b]New Features and Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added link for Bug Report form in Main Menu
[*] Added link to Steam Community in Main Menu
[*] Added support for Cloud Saves through Steam
[*] Added button to fast-forward through turn scoring 
[/list]

[h3]Important Note on Leaderboards[/h3]
We apologise for the annoyance that this may cause, but due to the nature of this update being a major balancing overhaul to remove an unintended exploit exhibiting incorrect scoring behaviour there will be a fresh leaderboard in place for v1.2 to maintain a fair chance at high scores for those unable to make use of the exploit - generally and almost always moving forward, an update resulting in a fresh leaderboard would [b]always[/b] be a major version update (i.e. 2.0.0, 3.0.0, etc) however with this being a relatively small update and one that doesn't introduce many new gameplay overhauls outside of repairing the exploit, we took the decision to maintain it as a crucial patch within the first major version update.
That being said, scores from v1.1 have not been deleted and in the 2.0.0 Major version update we will be adding Daily, Weekly and Monthly leaderboards in addition to the ability to view leaderboards from previous versions of the game.

Keep letting us know your feedback, it really does help a lot in improving our game for you all!

Big love and thanks,
~ Cuba and the Shiba Team 🥳✨
